text: Two causes, both mine. (1) The Bet button was hidden inside the expanded card: fixing so it sits on the card itself, always visible. (2) This sweep ran 90 s after the engine restart, before its first scan finished, so it had no Novig markets to build bet slips from (hence 'did not match'). The engine now waits for its first scan before sweeping. Right now the engine has finished a scan: pull down on the PropLine screen and the new sweep will give the lines that exist on Novig a Bet button. Releasing the always-visible button as v0.114.21 shortly.
